pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with semi-angular edge gradients. The shapes exhibit variable spatial area with jagged boundaries visible despite high image noise levels.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Lighter negative space forming an interconnected grid-like structure. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radiate and quadri-radiate. The pathways show consistent pixel thickness and continuity across the visible flank.
